import pathlib,subprocess,json,datetime,hashlib,re
E=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
rows=[]
for trial in range(1,6):
 order=['baseline','candidate'] if trial%2 else ['candidate','baseline']
 for version in order:
  cmd=['docker','run','--rm','--pull=never','--platform','linux/amd64','--cpuset-cpus','0-3','--memory','6g','-v',str(E)+':/bench:ro','--entrypoint','/bench/'+version+'.test','debian:12','-test.run','^$','-test.bench','^BenchmarkTransportBudget$/Bytes(64|65537)$/Workers(1|16)$/Budgetstrue$','-test.benchtime','2s','-test.count','1','-test.cpu','4','-test.benchmem']
  start=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat();p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180)
  (E/(str(trial)+'-'+version+'.txt')).write_text(p.stdout+p.stderr)
  assert p.returncode==0,(trial,version,p.stderr[-300:])
  assert 'goarch: arm64' in p.stdout
  hits=[]
  for line in p.stdout.splitlines():
   if line.startswith('BenchmarkTransportBudget/'):
    fields=line.split();m=re.search(r'Bytes(\d+)/Workers(\d+)/Budgetstrue',fields[0]);hits.append({'payload_bytes':int(m[1]),'workers':int(m[2]),'n':int(fields[1]),'ns_per_op':float(fields[2]),'bytes_per_op':int(fields[-4]),'allocs_per_op':int(fields[-2])})
  assert len(hits)==4
  rows.append({'trial':trial,'version':version,'start':start,'finish':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'command':cmd,'results':hits,'output':p.stdout,'output_sha256':hashlib.sha256((p.stdout+p.stderr).encode()).hexdigest()})
  (E/'timing.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({'trial':trial,'version':version,'results':hits}),flush=True)
